chunks: Mu'āwiyah ibn 'Ammār narrated from Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام:
He was asked, “Which 'umrah is better: an 'umrah in Rajab or an 'umrah in the month of Ramadan?” He said, “No, rather an 'umrah in the month of Rajab is better.”

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: Better or more excellent in merit
key_terms.رَجَبٍ: Rajab, the sacred month mentioned here as the more virtuous time
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: The month of Ramadan, compared here with Rajab regarding the merit of 'umrah

ai.seo_question: Which is better: performing 'umrah in Rajab or in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question posed to Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام about the relative merit of performing 'umrah in Rajab versus Ramadan. The Imam عليه السلام states that an 'umrah in Rajab is superior, indicating the special virtue of this month for this act of worship.
